name: mad-transit
description: Mad Transit: Madrid mobility monorepo (Spring Boot API + React web)

scripts.check:fast: pnpm typecheck:changed && pnpm --filter web lint && pnpm check:secrets && node scripts/floor-guard.mjs
scripts.check:task: pnpm check:fast && pnpm --filter web test && ./api/gradlew -p api test jacocoTestReport -q && node scripts/changed-coverage.mjs && pnpm --filter web depcruise
scripts.check:full: pnpm check:task && pnpm check:semgrep && pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high
scripts.check:semgrep: docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/src" -w /src semgrep/semgrep:1.140.0@sha256:4372a1de903521f9f10f877b6caf15d150d17e1ca592582682c8d02b77cbd4f6 semgrep scan --config p/default --config p/owasp-top-ten --severity ERROR --error --metrics=off --quiet --exclude node_modules --exclude api/build --exclude dist .
